output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND((SUM(l.net_amount) - SUM(l.cogs)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;
output.explanation: Gross margin % per product category for 2025, limited to revenue orders (is_revenue = true) by order_date. Margin is computed as (sum of line net_amount minus sum of line cogs) divided by sum of line net_amount, times 100, rounded to 2 decimals. Lines are joined to orders for the revenue flag and date, and to products for category. Shipping fees are excluded because they are not in line-level net_amount or cogs.
